page_title: STR 2-1 MET | Strasbourg v Metz 18/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Diego Moreira goes off the pitch and Kendry Paez (Strasbourg) comes on.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+1' Here is a change. Malick Mbaye is going off and Stephane Le Mignan gives the last tactical orders to Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz).
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Benjamin Stambouli (Metz) will replace Jean-Philippe Gbamin.
90+1' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
87' Gauthier Hein (Metz) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.

86' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jeremie Pignard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Metz.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ibou Sane trots off the pitch and is replaced by Joel Asoro (Metz).
80' Gary O'Neil decides to make a substitution. Martial Godo will be replaced by Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg).
80' Substitution. Julio Enciso makes his way off the pitch and Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) comes on as his replacement.
79' PENALTY APPEAL after Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
77' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
73' What a long-range shot by Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Metz). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar.
72' Substitution. Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) on for Fode Ballo-Toure.
72' Stephane Le Mignan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alpha Toure (Metz) replacing Jessy Deminguet.
70' The resulting free kick from Gauthier Hein (Metz) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
65' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) for Lucas Hogsberg.
64' The corner from Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) is intercepted by Jonathan Fischer.
62' Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Metz) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Mike Penders easily deals with the threat.
60' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
59' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
58' Today's referee Jeremie Pignard rightly decides to book Terry Yegbe (Metz) for his harsh tackle.

54' What a wasted opportunity by Julio Enciso (Strasbourg)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the left side of the goal, but Jonathan Fischer makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
51' Gauthier Hein (Metz) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley high over the bar from inside the box.
48' Ibou Sane (Metz) is flagged for offside.
46' The ball spins out to Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) and his swerving volley from the edge of the box flashes just past the left post.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jeremie Pignard didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

45+2' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) was in a good shooting position inside the six-yard box and produced a first-time shot low towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper made an astonishing save to thwart him.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

43' 2 - 1 Martial Godo produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Martial Godo (Strasbourg) rises high to head the ball into the left side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 2:1.

42' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Martial Godo (Strasbourg) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Jonathan Fischer easily catches the ball.
40' The opposing goalkeeper had set up the wall well before the free kick was executed and Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) failed to send the ball over. Great defensive action!
39' Jeremie Pignard shows the yellow card to Sadibou Sane (Metz) for a heavy challenge.
37' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the right-hand post.
37' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) strikes a volley towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.
36' A corner kick by Strasbourg is thwarted by the well prepared Jonathan Fischer (Metz).
35' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Strasbourg.
35' The corner is swung in but Strasbourg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

33' It's unbelievable, Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards goal from a few yards out, but Jonathan Fischer reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
29' Handball by Valentin Barco (Strasbourg).
28' Jessy Deminguet (Metz) decided to try his luck with a first-time shot, but blazed the ball way over the crossbar.
25' Lucas Hogsberg (Strasbourg) has received a yellow card for his foul.
25' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) was probably a bit loose with his words to Jeremie Pignard, who decides to show him a yellow.
24' 1 - 1 Gauthier Hein (Metz) finds the back of the net after sending the ball to the opposite side of the goal to which the goalkeeper dives!
23' Gauthier Hein (Metz) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
22' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) makes a rough challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul. A penalty is awarded to Metz!
17' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) is penalised for a foul. Jeremie Pignard had a clear view and blows his whistle.
17' Julio Enciso (Strasbourg) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
16' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Strasbourg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

12' 1 - 0 Stunning strike! Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) latches on to a precise through ball from Julio Enciso before unleashing an unstoppable shot inside the left post from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 1:0.
10' Ibou Sane (Metz) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
8' Malick Mbaye (Metz) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
8' Ben Chilwell (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but Jonathan Fischer comes off his line to gather the ball.
3' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
3' Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Metz) was too forceful with his tackle and Jeremie Pignard interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Metz will have the kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard will referee today's match.
